Inflammation of the diverted colon; diversion-associated inflammation does not establish an autoimmune mechanism.
Focal dystonia of pelvic floor skeletal muscle causes impaired defecation; no direct intestinal tissue damage is established.

Inflammation of the sigmoid colon and rectum; no specific infectious or autoimmune cause is established.
Disorder of purine metabolism with excess urinary xanthine; urinary excretion alone does not establish renal damage, and stones are a separate complication.
Familial nonmedullary carcinoma arising in the thyroid, an endocrine gland.

Inherited phosphate dysregulation with defective bone mineralization and rickets; renal phosphate wasting does not itself establish destructive kidney disease.
Painful subcutaneous lipomas define disease. Arthralgia and abdominal pain do not establish tissue damage; neuropathy is occasional, and metabolic conditions may co-occur.
Neurodevelopmental disorder with language delay in 4/4 and intellectual disability in 2/3; structural ocular and skeletal abnormalities occur in only 1/4.
Thrombosis and inflammation of the femoral vein; this does not itself establish a primary coagulation or autoimmune disorder.
INS-related permanent neonatal diabetes with insulin deficiency; no autoimmune mechanism or common direct extra-endocrine damage is established.
Malignant mesothelioma arising in the pleura.
Deficient gonadal endocrine function defines male hypogonadism; genital developmental findings do not add another axis.

Inherited mild elevation of LDL cholesterol is a lipid metabolic disorder; cardiovascular disease is a later risk and a separate diagnosis.
